Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: Incorrect comparison of director birth dates due to incorrect assignment of birth dates to the wrong directors. The Planner correctly identified Fernando di Leo's birth year as 1932 and Don Hahn's as 1955 in the "Updated Understanding" section. However, in the final decision step, the Planner incorrectly reasoned that because Don Hahn was older at the time of his film's release (54 vs 44), he must have been born earlier. This logic is flawed; being older at a later date (2009) does not imply being born earlier than someone who was younger at an earlier date (1976). The Planner failed to simply compare the birth years (1932 vs 1955) directly, leading to the wrong conclusion that Waking Sleeping Beauty's director was born earlier.
